AI Requirement Analysis:
AI Requirement Analysis:
AI Requirement Analysis for Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform:
1. Main Functional Requirements: Sub-millisecond ingestion endpoint buffering events into Redis queue; Compute moving metrics (count, sum, avg) over 1m, 5m, and 1h sliding windows; Authorize high-throughput event producers with hashed API keys and monitor EPS; Live reactive throughput graphs, event count tickers, and stream status overview; Architectural justification for Redis as an in-memory ring buffer and read cache.
2. Application Components: React SPA frontend, FastAPI REST backend, PostgreSQL database (User, StreamSource, Event, MetricAggregation).
3. User & Traffic Requirements: Scalable architecture supporting Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Event Producer Agent.
4. Data Requirements: Relational schema for User, StreamSource, Event, MetricAggregation with foreign key constraints.
5. Security Requirements: Password hashing, JWT token authentication, CORS security headers.
6. Availability & Scalability: Containerized deployment (AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers).
7. Important Technical Considerations: RESTful endpoints with consistent error status codes.

# ── DB Subnet Group ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "main" {
  name       = "${var.project_name}-db-subnet-group"
  subnet_ids = aws_subnet.private[*].id
  tags       = { Name = "${var.project_name}-db-subnet-group" }
}

# ── RDS Instance ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
resource "aws_db_instance" "main" {
  identifier             = "${var.project_name}-db"
  engine                 = "postgres"
  instance_class         = "db.t3.medium"
  allocated_storage      = 20
  storage_type           = "gp3"
  storage_encrypted      = true

  db_name  = var.db_name
  username = var.db_username
  password = var.db_password
  port     = var.db_port

  db_subnet_group_name   = aws_db_subnet_group.main.name
  vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.db.id]

  multi_az               = false
  publicly_accessible    = false
  skip_final_snapshot    = false
  final_snapshot_identifier = "${var.project_name}-final-snapshot"
  deletion_protection    = true

  backup_retention_period = 7
  backup_window           = "03:00-04:00"
  maintenance_window      = "Mon:04:00-Mon:05:00"

  enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports = ["postgresql", "upgrade"]

  tags = { Name = "${var.project_name}-db" }
}

files.README.md:
# SmartHome Live

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform
- **Description**: High-velocity streaming platform with Redis stream buffer, sliding window metrics, and cold PostgreSQL storage.
- **Primary Entity**: `Event`
- **Entities**: `User`, `StreamSource`, `Event`, `MetricAggregation`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS (Permanent Cold Storage)
- **Cache**: Redis 7 Cluster (Stream Buffer & In-Memory Real-time Aggregates - Justified)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Event Producers
    APP["Web & Mobile Apps"]
    SRV["Backend Microservices"]
    IOT["Edge Sensor Gateways"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Caching (Redis Justified)
    LB["High-Throughput NLB"]
    API["SmartHome Live Ingestion Gateway"]
    REDIS_STREAM[("Redis 7 Ingestion Buffer & Aggregate Cache")]
  end

  subgraph Worker & Aggregation
    AGGREGATOR["Stream Sliding-Window Aggregator Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Permanent Archival
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 Columnar/Timeseries Archival")]
    DASH["Live Stream Analytics Dashboard"]
  end

  APP --> LB --> API
  SRV --> LB --> API
  IOT --> LB --> API
  API --> REDIS_STREAM
  REDIS_STREAM --> AGGREGATOR
  AGGREGATOR --> REDIS_STREAM
  AGGREGATOR --> PG
  DASH --> REDIS_STREAM
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smarthome-live`

# Smart Home Dashboard - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import devices, sensorreadings, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="Smart Home Dashboard API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a smart home dashboard with rooms, devices, device status, monitoring, and...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(devices.router, prefix="/api/devices", tags=["Device Management"])
app.include_router(sensorreadings.router, prefix="/api/sensorreadings", tags=["SensorReading Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "Smart Home Dashboard", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to Smart Home Dashboard API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for Smart Home Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Device(Base):
    __tablename__ = "devices"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    device_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    room = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class SensorReading(Base):
    __tablename__ = "sensor_readings"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    unit = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class AlertRule(Base):
    __tablename__ = "alert_rules"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    condition = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    threshold = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)

# Automated Integration Tests for Smart Home Dashboard
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_devices():
    res = client.get("/api/devices/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_device():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Device", "name": "Automated Test Device", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/devices/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Device" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Device"

def test_ingest_telemetry():
    res = client.post("/api/devices/1/telemetry", json={"metric": "temperature", "value": 24.5})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "ingested"

files.README.md:
# Smart Home Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Smart Home IoT & Telemetry Platform
- **Description**: Smart home telemetry hub managing device registrations, live sensor streams, and threshold alerts.
- **Primary Entity**: `Device`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Device`, `SensorReading`, `AlertRule`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate Ingestion Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 with Time-Series B-tree Indexes
- **Cache**: None (direct indexing with time buckets)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph IoT Hardware & Edge
    DEV1["Smart Thermostats"]
    DEV2["Environmental Air Sensors"]
    DEV3["Smart Energy Plugs"]
  end

  subgraph Edge Protocols & Gateway
    MQTT["MQTT Broker / IoT Core Gateway"]
    HTTPS["Ingress API Gateway (HTTPS)"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Processing
    API["Smart Home Dashboard Ingestion Engine"]
    RULE_ENG["Threshold Alert Rule Evaluator"]
  end

  subgraph Storage Tier
    TS_DB[("PostgreSQL Time-Series Tables")]
    ALERTS[("Alert Notification Queue")]
  end

  DEV1 --> MQTT --> API
  DEV2 --> HTTPS --> API
  DEV3 --> MQTT --> API
  API --> RULE_ENG
  API --> TS_DB
  RULE_ENG --> ALERTS
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smart-home-dashboard`

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from backend.routes import devices, sensorreadings, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="Smart Home Dashboard API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a smart home dashboard with rooms, devices, device status, monitoring, and...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(devices.router, prefix="/api/devices", tags=["Device Management"])

# SQLAlchemy Models for Smart Home Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Device(Base):
    __tablename__ = "devices"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    device_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    room = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class SensorReading(Base):
    __tablename__ = "sensor_readings"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    unit = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class AlertRule(Base):
    __tablename__ = "alert_rules"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    condition = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    threshold = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)

# Automated Integration Tests for Smart Home Dashboard
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_devices():
    res = client.get("/api/devices/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_device():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Device", "name": "Automated Test Device", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/devices/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Device" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Device"

def test_ingest_telemetry():
    res = client.post("/api/devices/1/telemetry", json={"metric": "temperature", "value": 24.5})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "ingested"

files.README.md:
# Smart Home Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Smart Home IoT & Telemetry Platform
- **Description**: Smart home telemetry hub managing device registrations, live sensor streams, and threshold alerts.
- **Primary Entity**: `Device`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Device`, `SensorReading`, `AlertRule`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate Ingestion Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 with Time-Series B-tree Indexes
- **Cache**: None (direct indexing with time buckets)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph IoT Hardware & Edge
    DEV1["Smart Thermostats"]
    DEV2["Environmental Air Sensors"]
    DEV3["Smart Energy Plugs"]
  end

  subgraph Edge Protocols & Gateway
    MQTT["MQTT Broker / IoT Core Gateway"]
    HTTPS["Ingress API Gateway (HTTPS)"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Processing
    API["Smart Home Dashboard Ingestion Engine"]
    RULE_ENG["Threshold Alert Rule Evaluator"]
  end

  subgraph Storage Tier
    TS_DB[("PostgreSQL Time-Series Tables")]
    ALERTS[("Alert Notification Queue")]
  end

  DEV1 --> MQTT --> API
  DEV2 --> HTTPS --> API
  DEV3 --> MQTT --> API
  API --> RULE_ENG
  API --> TS_DB
  RULE_ENG --> ALERTS
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smart-home-dashboard`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Smart Home Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Device(Base):
    __tablename__ = "devices"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    device_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    room = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class SensorReading(Base):
    __tablename__ = "sensor_readings"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    unit = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class AlertRule(Base):
    __tablename__ = "alert_rules"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    condition = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    threshold = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)

files.README.md:
# Smart Home Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Smart Home IoT & Telemetry Platform
- **Description**: Smart home telemetry hub managing device registrations, live sensor streams, and threshold alerts.
- **Primary Entity**: `Device`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Device`, `SensorReading`, `AlertRule`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate Ingestion Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 with Time-Series B-tree Indexes
- **Cache**: None (direct indexing with time buckets)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph IoT Hardware & Edge
    DEV1["Smart Thermostats"]
    DEV2["Environmental Air Sensors"]
    DEV3["Smart Energy Plugs"]
  end

  subgraph Edge Protocols & Gateway
    MQTT["MQTT Broker / IoT Core Gateway"]
    HTTPS["Ingress API Gateway (HTTPS)"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Processing
    API["Smart Home Dashboard Ingestion Engine"]
    RULE_ENG["Threshold Alert Rule Evaluator"]
  end

  subgraph Storage Tier
    TS_DB[("PostgreSQL Time-Series Tables")]
    ALERTS[("Alert Notification Queue")]
  end

  DEV1 --> MQTT --> API
  DEV2 --> HTTPS --> API
  DEV3 --> MQTT --> API
  API --> RULE_ENG
  API --> TS_DB
  RULE_ENG --> ALERTS
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smart-home-dashboard`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class StreamSource(Base):
    __tablename__ = "stream_sources"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    api_key_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    events_per_sec = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Event(Base):
    __tablename__ = "events"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    source_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    event_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    payload_json = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)

class MetricAggregation(Base):
    __tablename__ = "metric_aggregations"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    metric_name = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    window_interval = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    count = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    sum_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    avg_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    window_end = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

files.README.md:
# Real-Time Analytics Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform
- **Description**: High-velocity streaming platform with Redis stream buffer, sliding window metrics, and cold PostgreSQL storage.
- **Primary Entity**: `Event`
- **Entities**: `User`, `StreamSource`, `Event`, `MetricAggregation`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS (Permanent Cold Storage)
- **Cache**: Redis 7 Cluster (Stream Buffer & In-Memory Real-time Aggregates - Justified)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Event Producers
    APP["Web & Mobile Apps"]
    SRV["Backend Microservices"]
    IOT["Edge Sensor Gateways"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Caching (Redis Justified)
    LB["High-Throughput NLB"]
    API["Real-Time Analytics Dashboard Ingestion Gateway"]
    REDIS_STREAM[("Redis 7 Ingestion Buffer & Aggregate Cache")]
  end

  subgraph Worker & Aggregation
    AGGREGATOR["Stream Sliding-Window Aggregator Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Permanent Archival
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 Columnar/Timeseries Archival")]
    DASH["Live Stream Analytics Dashboard"]
  end

  APP --> LB --> API
  SRV --> LB --> API
  IOT --> LB --> API
  API --> REDIS_STREAM
  REDIS_STREAM --> AGGREGATOR
  AGGREGATOR --> REDIS_STREAM
  AGGREGATOR --> PG
  DASH --> REDIS_STREAM
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/real-time-analytics-dashboard`

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status

    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],

# SQLAlchemy Models for Smart Home Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Device(Base):
    __tablename__ = "devices"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    device_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    room = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class SensorReading(Base):
    __tablename__ = "sensor_readings"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    unit = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class AlertRule(Base):
    __tablename__ = "alert_rules"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    condition = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    threshold = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)

# Automated Integration Tests for Smart Home Dashboard
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_devices():
    res = client.get("/api/devices/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_device():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Device", "name": "Automated Test Device", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/devices/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Device" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Device"

def test_ingest_telemetry():
    res = client.post("/api/devices/1/telemetry", json={"metric": "temperature", "value": 24.5})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "ingested"

# Smart Home Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Smart Home IoT & Telemetry Platform
- **Description**: Smart home telemetry hub managing device registrations, live sensor streams, and threshold alerts.
- **Primary Entity**: `Device`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Device`, `SensorReading`, `AlertRule`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate Ingestion Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 with Time-Series B-tree Indexes
- **Cache**: None (direct indexing with time buckets)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph IoT Hardware & Edge
    DEV1["Smart Thermostats"]
    DEV2["Environmental Air Sensors"]
    DEV3["Smart Energy Plugs"]
  end

  subgraph Edge Protocols & Gateway
    MQTT["MQTT Broker / IoT Core Gateway"]
    HTTPS["Ingress API Gateway (HTTPS)"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Processing
    API["Smart Home Dashboard Ingestion Engine"]
    RULE_ENG["Threshold Alert Rule Evaluator"]
  end

  subgraph Storage Tier
    TS_DB[("PostgreSQL Time-Series Tables")]
    ALERTS[("Alert Notification Queue")]
  end

  DEV1 --> MQTT --> API
  DEV2 --> HTTPS --> API
  DEV3 --> MQTT --> API
  API --> RULE_ENG
  API --> TS_DB
  RULE_ENG --> ALERTS
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smart-home-dashboard`

# Real-Time Analytics Dashboard - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import events, streamsources, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="Real-Time Analytics Dashboard API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a real-time analytics dashboard with event ingestion, aggregation, time-ba...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(events.router, prefix="/api/events", tags=["Event Management"])
app.include_router(streamsources.router, prefix="/api/streamsources", tags=["StreamSource Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "Real-Time Analytics Dashboard", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to Real-Time Analytics Dashboard API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class StreamSource(Base):
    __tablename__ = "stream_sources"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    api_key_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    events_per_sec = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Event(Base):

files.README.md:
# Real-Time Analytics Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform
- **Description**: High-velocity streaming platform with Redis stream buffer, sliding window metrics, and cold PostgreSQL storage.
- **Primary Entity**: `Event`
- **Entities**: `User`, `StreamSource`, `Event`, `MetricAggregation`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS (Permanent Cold Storage)
- **Cache**: Redis 7 Cluster (Stream Buffer & In-Memory Real-time Aggregates - Justified)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Event Producers
    APP["Web & Mobile Apps"]
    SRV["Backend Microservices"]
    IOT["Edge Sensor Gateways"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Caching (Redis Justified)
    LB["High-Throughput NLB"]
    API["Real-Time Analytics Dashboard Ingestion Gateway"]
    REDIS_STREAM[("Redis 7 Ingestion Buffer & Aggregate Cache")]
  end

  subgraph Worker & Aggregation
    AGGREGATOR["Stream Sliding-Window Aggregator Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Permanent Archival
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 Columnar/Timeseries Archival")]
    DASH["Live Stream Analytics Dashboard"]
  end

  APP --> LB --> API
  SRV --> LB --> API
  IOT --> LB --> API
  API --> REDIS_STREAM
  REDIS_STREAM --> AGGREGATOR
  AGGREGATOR --> REDIS_STREAM
  AGGREGATOR --> PG
  DASH --> REDIS_STREAM
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/real-time-analytics-dashboard`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class StreamSource(Base):
    __tablename__ = "stream_sources"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    api_key_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    events_per_sec = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Event(Base):
    __tablename__ = "events"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    source_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    event_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    payload_json = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)

class MetricAggregation(Base):
    __tablename__ = "metric_aggregations"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    metric_name = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    window_interval = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    count = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    sum_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    avg_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

files.README.md:
# Real-Time Analytics Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform
- **Description**: High-velocity streaming platform with Redis stream buffer, sliding window metrics, and cold PostgreSQL storage.
- **Primary Entity**: `Event`
- **Entities**: `User`, `StreamSource`, `Event`, `MetricAggregation`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS (Permanent Cold Storage)
- **Cache**: Redis 7 Cluster (Stream Buffer & In-Memory Real-time Aggregates - Justified)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Event Producers
    APP["Web & Mobile Apps"]
    SRV["Backend Microservices"]
    IOT["Edge Sensor Gateways"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Caching (Redis Justified)
    LB["High-Throughput NLB"]
    API["Real-Time Analytics Dashboard Ingestion Gateway"]
    REDIS_STREAM[("Redis 7 Ingestion Buffer & Aggregate Cache")]
  end

  subgraph Worker & Aggregation
    AGGREGATOR["Stream Sliding-Window Aggregator Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Permanent Archival
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 Columnar/Timeseries Archival")]
    DASH["Live Stream Analytics Dashboard"]
  end

  APP --> LB --> API
  SRV --> LB --> API
  IOT --> LB --> API
  API --> REDIS_STREAM
  REDIS_STREAM --> AGGREGATOR
  AGGREGATOR --> REDIS_STREAM
  AGGREGATOR --> PG
  DASH --> REDIS_STREAM
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/real-time-analytics-dashboard`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Smart Home Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Device(Base):
    __tablename__ = "devices"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    device_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    room = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class SensorReading(Base):
    __tablename__ = "sensor_readings"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    unit = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class AlertRule(Base):
    __tablename__ = "alert_rules"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    condition = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    threshold = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)

# Automated Integration Tests for Smart Home Dashboard
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_devices():
    res = client.get("/api/devices/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_device():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Device", "name": "Automated Test Device", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/devices/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Device" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Device"

def test_ingest_telemetry():
    res = client.post("/api/devices/1/telemetry", json={"metric": "temperature", "value": 24.5})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "ingested"

files.README.md:
# Smart Home Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Smart Home IoT & Telemetry Platform
- **Description**: Smart home telemetry hub managing device registrations, live sensor streams, and threshold alerts.
- **Primary Entity**: `Device`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Device`, `SensorReading`, `AlertRule`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate Ingestion Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 with Time-Series B-tree Indexes
- **Cache**: None (direct indexing with time buckets)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph IoT Hardware & Edge
    DEV1["Smart Thermostats"]
    DEV2["Environmental Air Sensors"]
    DEV3["Smart Energy Plugs"]
  end

  subgraph Edge Protocols & Gateway
    MQTT["MQTT Broker / IoT Core Gateway"]
    HTTPS["Ingress API Gateway (HTTPS)"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Processing
    API["Smart Home Dashboard Ingestion Engine"]
    RULE_ENG["Threshold Alert Rule Evaluator"]
  end

  subgraph Storage Tier
    TS_DB[("PostgreSQL Time-Series Tables")]
    ALERTS[("Alert Notification Queue")]
  end

  DEV1 --> MQTT --> API
  DEV2 --> HTTPS --> API
  DEV3 --> MQTT --> API
  API --> RULE_ENG
  API --> TS_DB
  RULE_ENG --> ALERTS
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smart-home-dashboard`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class StreamSource(Base):
    __tablename__ = "stream_sources"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    api_key_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    events_per_sec = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Event(Base):
    __tablename__ = "events"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    source_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    event_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    payload_json = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)

class MetricAggregation(Base):
    __tablename__ = "metric_aggregations"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    metric_name = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    window_interval = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    count = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    sum_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    avg_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

files.README.md:
# Real-Time Analytics Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform
- **Description**: High-velocity streaming platform with Redis stream buffer, sliding window metrics, and cold PostgreSQL storage.
- **Primary Entity**: `Event`
- **Entities**: `User`, `StreamSource`, `Event`, `MetricAggregation`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS (Permanent Cold Storage)
- **Cache**: Redis 7 Cluster (Stream Buffer & In-Memory Real-time Aggregates - Justified)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Event Producers
    APP["Web & Mobile Apps"]
    SRV["Backend Microservices"]
    IOT["Edge Sensor Gateways"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Caching (Redis Justified)
    LB["High-Throughput NLB"]
    API["Real-Time Analytics Dashboard Ingestion Gateway"]
    REDIS_STREAM[("Redis 7 Ingestion Buffer & Aggregate Cache")]
  end

  subgraph Worker & Aggregation
    AGGREGATOR["Stream Sliding-Window Aggregator Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Permanent Archival
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 Columnar/Timeseries Archival")]
    DASH["Live Stream Analytics Dashboard"]
  end

  APP --> LB --> API
  SRV --> LB --> API
  IOT --> LB --> API
  API --> REDIS_STREAM
  REDIS_STREAM --> AGGREGATOR
  AGGREGATOR --> REDIS_STREAM
  AGGREGATOR --> PG
  DASH --> REDIS_STREAM
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/real-time-analytics-dashboard`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class StreamSource(Base):
    __tablename__ = "stream_sources"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    api_key_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    events_per_sec = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Event(Base):
    __tablename__ = "events"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    source_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    event_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    payload_json = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)

class MetricAggregation(Base):
    __tablename__ = "metric_aggregations"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_list_events():

    assert res.status_code == 200

files.README.md:
# Real-Time Analytics Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform
- **Description**: High-velocity streaming platform with Redis stream buffer, sliding window metrics, and cold PostgreSQL storage.
- **Primary Entity**: `Event`
- **Entities**: `User`, `StreamSource`, `Event`, `MetricAggregation`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS (Permanent Cold Storage)
- **Cache**: Redis 7 Cluster (Stream Buffer & In-Memory Real-time Aggregates - Justified)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Event Producers
    APP["Web & Mobile Apps"]
    SRV["Backend Microservices"]
    IOT["Edge Sensor Gateways"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Caching (Redis Justified)
    LB["High-Throughput NLB"]
    API["Real-Time Analytics Dashboard Ingestion Gateway"]
    REDIS_STREAM[("Redis 7 Ingestion Buffer & Aggregate Cache")]
  end

  subgraph Worker & Aggregation
    AGGREGATOR["Stream Sliding-Window Aggregator Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Permanent Archival
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 Columnar/Timeseries Archival")]
    DASH["Live Stream Analytics Dashboard"]
  end

  APP --> LB --> API
  SRV --> LB --> API
  IOT --> LB --> API
  API --> REDIS_STREAM
  REDIS_STREAM --> AGGREGATOR
  AGGREGATOR --> REDIS_STREAM
  AGGREGATOR --> PG
  DASH --> REDIS_STREAM
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/real-time-analytics-dashboard`
